summary: Independent browser review of /en, /th and /zh /products/tutor-advantage at 390, 768, 980 and 1280 px on a fresh build of audited head d279b8703. Every required check passed: section order, no horizontal scroll, no clipped figures, default/preset/leg/hand-edit/extreme-price states, on-screen arithmetic, graph and rate-curve agreement, keyboard path and focus ring, locale rendering, aria-live announcements, no layout shift, and accessibility names. One nonblocking edge-case observation is open.
nonblocking_findings: F1 (minor, 12 screens, state extreme-price-students-4): price typed 1e307 with 4 own students shows 4e+307 in the rows 'Your own volume' and 'Network volume', while gross, downline, tax and net show 0. No error text appears and no page error is thrown. The required gate passes in the default state: price 1e307 shows zero money in every money row and no error. The huge volume matches the pinned module contract A6, which keeps networkVolume finite and gross at 0. Owner decides whether the volume rows need a zero or a formatted cap.
